rationale: Single-line fix: adds `hint={field.description}` to the `<Switch>` in the `BOOLEAN` branch of `IndexProviderForm.tsx`. Every other field type (LIST→Autocomplete, STRING/SECRET/URL→Input, TEXT→Textarea) already passes this prop; the BOOLEAN branch was the only one omitting it. `Switch` renders `{hint && <TooltipButton .../>}`, so the icon was simply never mounted. No logic change, no new state, no API change — the `description` field is already present in `DataProviderField` and already returned by `GET /v1/providers/datasource_schemas`. Verified locally: browser screenshot confirms the info icon appears next to the toggle after the fix and is absent without it.

standards_review.notes: Commit subject follows 'EPMCDME-17517: Capital sentence' per .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md.
Diff adds one prop to a Switch component. No HTML sinks, no navigation from untrusted input, no secrets, no config changes per .ai-run/guides/development/security-patterns.md.
